affected_subject.reason: Identifies RiskEngine.twapEMA() and its downstream use in PanopticPool.getTWAP().

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: twapEMA() destructures getEMAs() return values in wrong order, activated when short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA.

direct_effect.reason: Actual formula (6*slow+3*fast+spot)/10 replaces intended (6*fast+3*slow+eons)/10, altering StaleOracle boundary and solvency outcomes.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual formula mismatch and intended manipulation-resistant TWAP vs actual spot-weighted blend give a derivable safety relation for stale/solvency checks.

summary: Report specifies affected function, wrong destructuring trigger, concrete formula deviation and downstream stale/solvency effects, with expected-vs-actual basis sufficient to attempt formalization.
